scope: First service-evidence follow-up for ten newly eligible Indian Sixth Schedule autonomous legislatures. Inventory eligibility was decided separately; this report does not recertify current members or authorize catalogue promotion.
method: Official primary sources only for findings. Direct public retrieval and indexed official-page text are distinguished. Page titles, navigational links, provider designations, sitting notices and decoded playback are distinct evidence levels. Empty searches never establish absence of streams.
interpretation_limits: Retrieval status belongs to this research tool and review date, not to the institution or all browsers.
Official media designation does not prove legislative content, stream stability or any reuse right.
Sitting time is not necessarily broadcast time; do not synthesize a broadcast duration or timezone from location.
A public URL, copyright footer or own-site player does not by itself settle linking, third-party embedding, direct playback, recording, redistribution or programme-data licensing.
No outreach, access-control bypass, playback decoding, credential retention or raw HTML archiving was performed.
